main.description: The embedding model every vector in a memory space must come from. Written by the space authority in its own repo in the space. Appviews only honor this record from the authority.

documentPrefix.description: Text to put before a memory's text when embedding it, for models trained with task prefixes (nomic-embed-text uses "search_document: ").

queryPrefix.description: Text to put before a query when embedding it (nomic-embed-text uses "search_query: ").

next.description: The model a change is moving to. While set, agents also write nextEmbedding for their memories, and appviews build a second index. Promote it by making it the main model.
